case.title: Retraction due to duplicate publication
case.spec_ref: **Retraction grounds (COPE).** "Findings are unreliable" — major error, fabrication, falsification, redundant publication, unauthorised material, compromised peer review. Several of these are *structural* facts about a record (duplicate publication = near-identical claims presented as independent) rather than judgements of truth.

claim.statement: The article contains duplicate claims that render its findings unreliable.

evidence.title: COPE retraction notice for article-567
evidence.description: The editorial board issued a retraction notice citing duplicate publication of near‑identical claims as the sole reason for unreliability, in accordance with COPE guidelines.

evidence.title: COPE policy compliance assessment
evidence.description: The policy engine confirmed that the retraction meets COPE’s criteria for findings being unreliable due to duplication and compromised peer review.
